title: A machine without Tailscale could not open the page the campaign built
foundBy: user report (host): "We have to fall back if tailscale isn't present"

evidence.verified: With a `tailscale` that prints nothing placed first on `PATH`, `make show-reports` served both pages on `127.0.0.1`, and each answered 200. A full `make demo-replay` run the same way forwarded the app with `--bind 127.0.0.1`, and the page answered 200 there. The same ports on the machine's Tailscale address did not answer. With Tailscale up, both targets still print the Tailscale address.

details:
`make show-app` and `make show-reports` both stopped with `no Tailscale IPv4 address` on a machine where Tailscale was not running. The reports open from disk, so a reader could still read those. The app runs inside the orchestrator's sandbox, so without the forward there was no way to open it at all. The step that ends with a served page ended with an error.

Both targets now serve on `127.0.0.1` when Tailscale gives no address, and say that they did. `BIND_ADDR` chooses an address outright. Neither binds to every interface, because the app and the reports are not meant for a shared network.
